hints.tr: İşin altına `strategy:`, onun altına `matrix:`, onun altına `os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]`.
hints.en: Under the job `strategy:`, under it `matrix:`, under that `os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]`.

hints.tr: `runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}` yazmazsan bütün işler yine Linux'ta çalışır.
hints.en: If you do not write `runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}`, all jobs still run on Linux.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on: push

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
